info.name: EMS Reinigungsservice - Mobile API
info.description:
Postman reference for the employee mobile app, aligned to the real API and field workflow shown in the mobile flow.

START HERE
1. Set `base_url` and `email` / `password` to an active Mitarbeiter account. The collection logs in automatically and stores its Sanctum token.
2. For requests marked Vorarbeiter only, change credentials to an active Vorarbeiter account and clear `token` before sending. A normal Mitarbeiter must receive 403 for leader-only actions.
3. Select real IDs from the employee's assigned work and copy them to the matching variables. Do not assume IDs are 1.

EMPLOYEE FLOWS
- Fixobjekt: read assigned schedules -> start the scheduled visit -> upload before photos -> cleaning -> upload after photos -> complete. No Vorarbeiter is involved. Contract hours, not elapsed time, count in the report.
- Extra-Auftrag: each assigned employee records travel, arrival, work start, optional breaks, field notes and their own handover. The Vorarbeiter uploads photos, completes the checklist and closes the order; that final action freezes the team's executions.

IDENTIFIERS
`{{schedule_id}}` is a Fixobjekt visit; `{{fix_execution_id}}` is its execution; `{{order_id}}` is an assigned Extra-Auftrag; `{{execution_id}}` is an Extra-Auftrag execution; `{{travel_track_id}}` is the separate travel/GPS track. Start requests save execution IDs automatically. Select `{{location_id}}` and `{{complaint_id}}` from real responses.

FIELD RULES
- Use the multipart `/extra-orders/{id}/photos/upload` endpoint for actual image files. It accepts up to 10 JPEG, PNG or WebP photos (20 MB each); uploaded images are private and returned as authenticated preview URLs.
- Extra-Auftrag before/after photos, checklist updates and whole-order completion are Vorarbeiter-only. Travel, arrival, work start, breaks, notes and personal work handover are available to assigned employees.
- `key_returned` and `alarm_activated` must reflect the site setup; `windows_closed` is always required at handover.
- If work started with GPS, the matching work-end request must include `gps_work_end_lat` / `gps_work_end_lng`.
- Financial fields such as `price`, `internal_cost`, company payouts and profitability are never exposed to field staff.

item.name: 1 - Auth & Profile
item.description: Sign in, read and change the display language, change the password, register the push token.

request.description: Returns the Sanctum token in `data.token`, plus the user profile with its role. Canonical route: POST /api/v1/auth/login.
Basic info of the authenticated user: id, name, email, role, locale, last_login_at.
Employee profile. Sensitive fields (hourly_rate, iban) are never exposed.
Employee may only update locale and phone.
Returns the current `locale` and the `locales` list the app renders in the language picker.
One of de / en / ar. This request sets Arabic; send `de` afterwards to put the rest of the collection back into German. The response lists what actually changed in `data.changed`.
WARNING: this really changes the password and revokes every other device session. Reset the `password` variable afterwards.

Send the OneSignal Player ID (the per-installation device id from the OneSignal SDK, not the FCM registration token). Re-sending the same id replaces the existing row instead of duplicating it. Max 5 devices per user.

Revokes the Sanctum token the rest of the collection uses. WARNING: because this now sits in folder 1, running the whole collection in order will revoke the token here and every later request will come back 401. Clear the `token` variable back to `{{sanctum_bearer_token}}` afterwards so the pre-request script logs in again, or just send this request on its own when you are done.

item.name: 2 - Calendar & Tasks
item.description: The day's assigned work, the job detail, and the unified calendar.

request.description: Active Extra-Aufträge assigned to the signed-in employee. The response never contains price, internal_cost or profitability. Take an `id` from here for `{{order_id}}`, and `location.id` for `{{location_id}}`.
A Vorarbeiter also sees the team list; a Mitarbeiter sees only their own record. Never contains price or internal_notes.

`from` / `to` are optional; omitting them returns a 7-day window ending today. The response carries a `layers` legend, and every event in `data` has a `layer` key that must exist in that legend. `show_personal=true` forces the personal layer on. Filter with `layers=extra,shifts`, and plan for someone else with `employee=<id>` (Vorarbeiter/Admin only).
Same endpoint with the layer toggles the calendar filter bar sends. `fix` = Fixobjekte; the other layer keys come back in the legend.
NOTE: the specification asked for POST /api/v1/personal-events. The implemented route is POST /api/v1/appointments - this collection uses the real one.
Canonical unified calendar. Alias /api/v1/calendar/events behaves identically. Optional from/to/layers/employee.
Only fix objects assigned to the employee. Zero financial data. Take an id for the next two requests.
Employee must be assigned to the object, otherwise 404. Set `fix_object_id` from List Fix Objects.
Own schedules only (executions filtered to the caller). Set `schedule_id` from the returned schedule before starting its visit. Optional ?from=&to=.

item.name: 3 - Fixobjekt Workflow (Mitarbeiter)
item.description: A Fixobjekt has no Vorarbeiter. The assigned Mitarbeiter completes the visit independently: start -> before photos -> cleaning -> after photos -> complete. Contract hours are reported, not elapsed work time.

request.description: Assigned Mitarbeiter only. Save the response `data.id` as `fix_execution_id` (captured automatically).
Assigned employee updates only their own execution. Upload the actual images to storage first, then send their paths.
Advance after the before-photo step.
Assigned employee uploads after photos after cleaning.
Completes the employee's own execution and marks the scheduled visit complete. The report counts frozen contract hours, not elapsed start/end time.

item.name: 4 - Extra-Auftrag Workflow
item.description: Each assigned employee records their own travel, arrival, work, breaks and handover. The Vorarbeiter uploads photos and completes the checklist before closing the order; that final action freezes the team's executions. Leader-only photo/checklist requests must use the leader's own execution ID.

request.description: Assigned employee starts the trip. The response data.id is a TravelTrack ID, not an execution ID; it is saved to {{travel_track_id}} for GPS updates.
Record arrival before starting work. Use the same assigned order and employee that started travel.
Vorarbeiter only. Select up to 10 JPEG, PNG or WebP files (max 20 MB each). Files are stored privately; the response includes authenticated preview URLs.
After travel and arrival, the assigned employee starts work. The response data.id is the ExtraAuftragExecution ID saved to {{execution_id}}.
The break is unpaid and is deducted from paid_minutes at hand-over. `paused_at` is optional; the server falls back to now().
Freezes `pause_minutes` on the execution. Wait a minute between 4.5 and 4.6 to get a non-zero value.
Appends to employee_notes rather than overwriting them.
Vorarbeiter only. Every item needs a `completed` flag; an unticked item blocks order completion.
Intern documents are invisible to field staff even here. `visibility=extern` is optional and cannot widen the result. The response never exposes the storage path.
Same multipart endpoint as 4.3 with stage=after. The before photos from 4.3 remain attached.

Call this once for each assigned employee using that employee's credentials. Every employee confirms site security and ends their own work. Before/after photos and checklist are validated only against the Vorarbeiter's execution, because regular employees cannot update them. GPS is mandatory if that employee started work with GPS. The Vorarbeiter must finish documentation before the final order close.
Leader only: closes the whole order. Requires before/after photos + a complete checklist on the leader execution. If 4.4 started with GPS, submit the closing GPS coordinates here too.

item.name: 5 - Complaints & Reopen
item.description: Damage reports from the field, and the governance path for reopening a closed job.

request.description: Creates the complaint as `pending`. The response `data.id` is the `{{complaint_id}}` used by Get Complaint Detail.

Paginated: `meta` carries total, page, per_page. Filter with status=pending|in_progress|resolved|rejected, location_id, client_id, assigned_employee_id. per_page is 1-100. The response never contains internal_notes or internal_cost.
Same endpoint with the status filter the complaint tabs send.
Administrator or Vorarbeiter only, never a plain Mitarbeiter. The reason is mandatory and audited. Use `schedule-<id>` in the path to reopen a Fixobjekt schedule instead of an Extra-Auftrag.

item.name: 6 - Travel, Notifications & Reports
item.description: Travel, GPS, time, notifications and the self-service report - the rest of what the app calls.

request.description: The worker never sees the rate - the response has no hourly_cost.
Profitability is Administrator-only; a field device gets neither revenue nor internal_cost.
Batch GPS upload for offline sync. Single-point endpoint: POST /api/v1/travel-tracks/{{travel_track_id}}/gps.
Own adjustment requests with status (pending/approved/rejected) and reviewer info.
